experiences.title: Data Analyst Intern
experiences.description: Engineered a Snowflake data mart consolidating 2M+ claims and billing records, improving KPI accuracy across denial management, reimbursement tracking, and turnaround time for 4 operational teams. Built 5 Power BI and Tableau dashboards tracking denial rates, payer mix, and aging buckets using DAX measures, reducing manual reporting time by 20% and delivering real-time visibility to leadership. Designed and executed SQL pipelines to validate and reconcile data across 3 source systems, eliminating mismatches by 30% and strengthening data integrity for downstream analytics. Implemented 8 automated quality checks with real-time anomaly alerts, cutting root cause analysis time and improving payment reporting accuracy across billing workflows. Synthesized weekly revenue cycle metrics for operations leadership, enabling data-driven prioritization of payer escalations and claim resubmission strategies.

Architected automated Power BI and Excel dashboards with 20+ dynamic visualizations, cutting manual reporting effort by 25% and accelerating trend identification for senior stakeholders. Delivered weekly and monthly performance analyses translating raw operational data into measurable business insights, supporting strategic decisions across revenue and operations functions. Diagnosed and resolved 3 critical data pipeline gaps impacting downstream reporting accuracy, collaborating with operations teams to remediate upstream data entry issues.
